title: C/F order 遍历缓存友好性（仅布尔判据）
expected_output:
A C-contiguous = True
行总和 == 列总和（数学相等）: True
连续行遍历更快: True
列跳跃遍历更慢(加速比>1.2): True
说明：绝对耗时随机器波动，此处只给布尔判据保证可复现。
code:
import time
import numpy as np
n = 3000
A = np.random.default_rng(0).random((n, n))   # C contiguous
t0 = time.perf_counter()
r1 = [float(A[i].sum()) for i in range(n)]     # 按行（连续）
t_row = time.perf_counter() - t0
t0 = time.perf_counter()
r2 = [float(A[:, j].sum()) for j in range(n)]  # 按列（跨行跳跃）
t_col = time.perf_counter() - t0
total_row = sum(r1)
total_col = sum(r2)
print("A C-contiguous =", bool(A.flags['C_CONTIGUOUS']))
print("行总和 == 列总和（数学相等）:", np.isclose(total_row, total_col))
print("连续行遍历更快:", t_row < t_col)
print("列跳跃遍历更慢(加速比>1.2):", t_col / t_row > 1.2)
print("说明：绝对耗时随机器波动，此处只给布尔判据保证可复现。")
